items.heading: Checked on 15 November 2026
items.text: Checked on 15 November 2026. Pay differs by city, employer, skill and year, so treat every row as a range to test, not a promise.

items.heading: The Mpt Is a Two
items.text: The MPT is a two-year postgraduate degree in one specialty. Whether it moves your salary depends on whether the post you want asks for it.

items.heading: A Government Post Pays
items.text: A government post pays by the pay matrix of that post. The Delhi draft rule places physiotherapists at Level 6, which is Rs 35,400 to Rs 1,12,400 a month in basic pay, and your take-home depends on allowances and city. Read the pay matrix and the qualification line in the exact recruitment notice you plan to apply to.
